name: Akashic Health Records Patient Portal
author: codemonkeys

sections.description:
Your practice. Your health. Better connected.

Bring online patient appointment booking, telehealth video visits, electronic health records (EHR), patient messaging, and practice management to your WordPress website with Akashic. Patients get a patient portal; healthcare staff get workspaces for scheduling, clinical care, and running the practice.

Patients use their own Akashic account across participating practices. They can manage appointments, read their records, complete forms, message their practice, and choose family members or caregivers who can help. Staff get access according to their role and the patient’s sharing permissions.

An Akashic account and an internet connection are required. The plugin connects your website to the hosted Akashic service; it is not a standalone records system. Practices can start with the free plan, including the first clinician seat. Additional clinician seats and optional add-ons may require payment. Patient accounts are free; charges from a practice for healthcare are separate. Visit akashic.health for current features and pricing.

Third-Party Services

This plugin communicates with the hosted Akashic service when you set up a practice, sign in, or use a portal or form. It sends information you submit for the requested action, such as account details, appointment requests, messages, questionnaire answers, health records, and uploaded files. It also sends authentication and request metadata needed to authorize those actions.

  • Akashic API: Akashic uses AWS API Gateway to route authenticated requests to its services. These handle practice setup, appointments, records, messages, and other requested actions.

    • Service URL: https://api.akashichealthrecords.com/R4
    • AWS Service Terms
    • AWS Privacy Notice

  • AWS HealthLake: Used for clinical FHIR data storage and retrieval. Files are stored in AWS S3; account and workflow information also uses AWS DynamoDB.

    • Service URL: https://healthlake.amazonaws.com/
    • AWS Service Terms
    • AWS Privacy Notice

  • AWS Textract (upcoming OCR workflows): When available, referral fax and medical record OCR will send uploaded documents to AWS Textract to extract text for staff review.

    • AWS Textract
    • AWS Service Terms
    • AWS Privacy Notice

  • AWS account and communication services: Cognito handles authentication; WebSocket connections provide live updates. Messaging and video features may also use AWS communications services.

    • Service URL: wss://wss.akashichealthrecords.com
    • AWS Service Terms
    • AWS Privacy Notice

  • Stripe: When you use payments, subscriptions, or identity verification, Stripe receives the information needed for that transaction or verification. Payment details are submitted through Stripe’s interfaces; transaction results are returned to Akashic. These features require the relevant account or practice configuration.

    • Service URL: https://stripe.com/
    • Stripe Terms of Service
    • Stripe Privacy Policy

  • Cloudflare Turnstile: Protected public forms and demo entry may use Turnstile to check for automated abuse. The browser sends browser and network information to Cloudflare; the resulting challenge token is submitted to Akashic for verification.

    • Challenge script: https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js
    • Cloudflare Terms
    • Cloudflare Privacy Policy

Production also uses the fhir-*.akashichealthrecords.com APIs and https://terminology.akashichealthrecords.com/fhir. Authentication uses AWS Cognito in the us-east-1 region. File transfers use authorized S3 URLs returned by the service. Akashic’s applicable agreements are presented in the application during account and practice setup; see akashic.health for service information.

Patient appointment booking and scheduling

Let patients book appointments from your practice website. Staff can manage the appointment calendar, check patients in, reschedule visits, and cancel appointments. Configure practice locations, services, and booking rules for your workflow.

Telehealth video visits

Provide telehealth appointments with video and audio for patients and clinicians. Patients enter their visit through the patient portal, and staff manage the visit from their workspace.

Electronic health records (EHR)

Work with medical records including medications, allergies, conditions, visit notes, lab results, and care plans. Akashic uses FHIR R4 resources in its hosted records service. Patients use one Akashic account across participating practices, with access governed by roles and sharing permissions.

Patient messaging and care teams

Give patients and authorized staff a place to exchange messages and follow up on care. Family members and caregivers can help through patient-controlled sharing permissions.

Patient intake and HIPAA forms

Collect intake questionnaires, medical history, and patient agreements through your website. Publish public forms using the Akashic Public Form block or the supplied embed, and let patients complete requested forms in their portal. For practices seeking HIPAA-compliant forms, Akashic supplies access controls and agreement workflows; compliance also depends on the practice’s agreements, policies, and website safeguards.

Practice management and billing

Manage staff access by role, practice locations, services, tasks, and clinical workflows. Use invoices and patient payments when your practice has a payment gateway configured. Practices can start with the free clinician seat and add optional paid capacity.

Upcoming: medical records requests, fax OCR, and record import

The Records workspace being completed brings incoming and outgoing medical records requests together with patient matching, packet preparation, review, approval, and delivery. Planned packet choices include records related to the sending practice or all records permitted for that disclosure.

Fax OCR is being completed for both referral faxes and received medical records. It will extract text into drafts for staff review, with uncertain information left for staff to resolve. Structured record import will let authorized staff review proposed data before filing it into the patient’s record; OCR suggestions do not become confirmed clinical data automatically.

These workflows are upcoming and are not yet available in the published 1.0 package. External SMART on FHIR connections are separate planned follow-up work.

Development

This plugin is built using React and TypeScript. The source code is included in the /src directory of this plugin.

The plugin uses the following structure:
– /src – React/TypeScript source files
– /build – Compiled JavaScript
– /includes – PHP includes
– /assets – Static assets like images and CSS

To rebuild the production browser files, install the locked dependencies with npm ci, set the environment variable AKASHIC_STACK=prod, and run npm run build. Use a Node.js version supported by the included dependencies and npm 11 or later. Run node scripts/sync-version.js to align the PHP version with the readme’s stable tag.
sections.installation:
1. Install Akashic Health Records Patient Portal from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the release ZIP using Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Akashic Health Records Patient Portal in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Follow the setup steps to create or connect your practice, complete the required agreements, and configure staff, services, locations, and scheduling.
  5. Use the portal-page controls to publish the patient and staff portals. For a manually created page, use [akashere_patient_portal] for patients or [akashere_staff_portal] for staff.
  6. For a public form, publish the form in Akashic and use the Akashic Public Form block or its supplied embed on a WordPress page.

An HTTPS website is required. Avoid adding advertising, analytics, or other third-party scripts to portal pages that could capture health information.
sections.faq:
Does installing this plugin make my website HIPAA compliant?

Installing a plugin does not establish compliance. Akashic provides authentication, access controls, sharing permissions, and audit features. Your organization must also address its agreements, policies, staff practices, hosting, and other safeguards.

Do patients need a WordPress account?

No. Patients and staff sign in with their Akashic accounts. A WordPress administrator installs the plugin and opens the initial practice setup.

Can I use Akashic without WordPress?

Yes. Akashic also provides hosted portals. This plugin is for practices that want portal access on their WordPress website.

Is everything stored in my WordPress database?

No. Health records and uploaded files are handled by the hosted Akashic service. WordPress stores the plugin’s installation settings and published pages. Removing the plugin does not delete the records held by Akashic.

Can I connect this to my existing EHR system?

Akashic uses FHIR R4 internally. External SMART on FHIR connections are planned follow-up work and are not included in version 1.0.

What types of healthcare providers can use this plugin?

Akashic Health Records is designed to be flexible and can be used by various healthcare providers, including primary care physicians, specialists, mental health providers, physical therapists, and more. The customizable forms and workflows can be adapted to different healthcare specialties.

Where can I get help or report a problem?

Use the WordPress.org support forum or visit akashic.health. Do not include patient information, login codes, or other private information in public support posts.

How does the plugin handle patient data security?

Akashic uses authentication, role-based access controls, sharing permissions, and audit logging. The plugin requires HTTPS to load the portals. The practice remains responsible for staff access and its website configuration.
